scope: Reconcile current primary GDAL, ezdxf, and LibreCAD_3 documentation into a version-pinned, implementation-ready comparator order without changing implementation findings or support claims.

method.kind: primary documentation review and local plan reconciliation
notPerformed: No peer application or native CAD consumer was installed or run.
No third-party DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB file was downloaded or committed.
No external runtime, license, platform, or geometry-semantic result was qualified.

observed: GDAL documents a built-in DXF driver and Binary DXF reading beginning with GDAL 3.12.
DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASMData and a 12-real column-major ASMTransform for AC1027+ DXF; it does not create OGR solid geometry.
DXF_INLINE_BLOCKS=FALSE preserves block definitions and INSERT references as separate structures suitable for owner/path inspection.
The driver matrix identifies DWG as requiring the external ODA Teigha library, unlike built-in DXF.
notEstablished: A selected installed build supports Binary DXF and 3D extensible mode together.
Raw ASM extraction validates ACIS semantics, DWG ACDS linkage, or B-rep topology.
evidence.planUse: One optional, pinned, composed DXF feature-projection/raw-carrier comparison; separate ASCII and Binary DXF cells, preserve blocks, record per-handle/type/owner disposition, payload hash and transform, and report NOT_RUN if unavailable.

observed: Documentation exposes raw SAT/SAB inspection and parsing.
mesh_from_body projects flat polygonal faces and documents curved-face loss; vertices_from_body bounds are exact only for polyhedra with flat faces and straight edges.
body_from_mesh can create a locally generated polyhedral ACIS control.
Recovery/audit is a repair and diagnostic path for flawed files; documented decode errors can remain unrecoverable and recovered writeback may lose or invalidate information.
notEstablished: Arbitrary imported ACIS B-rep validity or curved surface semantics.
A recovered drawing is equivalent to clean strict parsing or lossless round-trip.
evidence.planUse: Use strict read as a parser observation, recovery only as separate diagnostics on a damaged local control, and body_from_mesh only for ephemeral from-scratch carrier generation; keep faceted results below B-rep semantic evidence.

observed: Project documentation says WITH_DWG_IMPORT is off by default and the dwgRW reader is experimental.
Project documentation says DWG writing is not implemented, exposed, or planned pending its stated acceptance conditions.
notEstablished: A library callback alone proves application model construction or feature fidelity.
A LibreCAD_3 compatibility objective implies a DWG writer requirement.
evidence.planUse: Keep the integration gate reader-only and distinct from DWG write and 3D ACIS claims.

implementationOrder: Per-slice generated fast test, touched strict build, and per-entity/owner output inventory.
One composed pinned GDAL DXF structural/raw-carrier comparison after related slices compose.
Complementary ezdxf strict parse, with recovery/audit diagnostics kept separate.
After carrier and graph closure, an eligible independent ACIS reader/kernel for B-rep and analytic invariants.
Separate exact-lineage DWG reader comparison and LibreCAD_3 reader integration; no DWG write implication.
